en: llama-server exited immediately after launch — port {port} may already be in use, or the model file may be corrupt

en: Local AI auto-launch supports 127.0.0.1 only; provider address is {host}, not auto-launching this run (a manually started service is unaffected)

en: Speaks in short bursts; snorts when impatient.

en: Cares most about no one touching their things.

zh_TW:
資料庫初始化失敗，遊戲無法繼續啟動。

存檔資料庫：{path}

可能是這個資料庫的版本跟目前遊戲版本不相容（例如切換到較舊的分支/版本）。
請查看遊戲 log 或聯絡開發者處理；必要時可備份後刪除上面這個檔案讓遊戲重建一份全新的資料庫。
en:
Database initialization failed; the game cannot start.

Save database: {path}

The database version is probably incompatible with this build (e.g. you switched to an older branch/version).
Check the game log or contact the developer; if needed, back up and delete the file above to let the game rebuild a fresh database.
